about: A check loop runs over a production loop's .items (chapter 6 § 6.3.1). Invalid: the check loop section_coverage runs over node.standards.value, the sections' text (and names its items by nothing, as a list of text has no labels). Valid: node.standards.items, each named by its label.
sentences: Check loop 'section_coverage' runs over node.standards.value; a check loop runs over a production loop's .items.
